activity_summary: At the Bull, close on nine, Nashe was still at war with Harvey, who was not in the room. You told him he was the page, not the pedant and not the braggart. Phillips got one verse out of him. Burbage got a penny for one cup. Heminges said the company had come through its first winter without a quarrel over the purse, and he touched the table. The supper was tenpence a head. You left on the purse.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the page, lent nothing, and left on the purse.

entities.name: Thomas Nashe
entities.context: Came uninvited, spent the room on Harvey, sang one verse, and paid a penny.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Made Nashe pay for one cup, and told you to go before you lent him anything.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Got one verse, and refused a second.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Ate through the argument, and kept the fast outside the parlour.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Asked to fast from explanations, and stayed with the marrow.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named tenpence a head, reported a winter without a purse-quarrel, and touched the table.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The page, and a penny

facets.activity: Told Nashe he was the page

quotes.speaker: thomas_pope
quotes.text: May a man fast from another man's explanations?

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: We have come through our first winter as a company without one quarrel over the purse.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is close on nine. I am in pain.
